zh: RTP：实时传输协议，承载媒体流。
profile：在既有协议上叠加规则的剖面。
message authentication：消息认证，来源与完整性。
replay protection：重放防护，依赖包序与窗口。
en: RTP: the Real-time Transport Protocol carrying media.
Profile: rules layered onto an existing protocol.
Message authentication: origin and integrity of a message.
Replay protection: rejecting re-injected packets via ordering and windows.
